name: Report Transaction Request 1
definition: Content of the Transaction Report Request message.

SearchCriteria.name: Search Criteria
SearchCriteria.definition: Eligibility parameters for a transaction to be part of transaction report.

SearchOutputOrder.name: Search Output Order
SearchOutputOrder.definition: Indicates the ordering in which the resulting transaction reports should be returned.

DescendingOrder.name: Descending Order
DescendingOrder.definition: Indicates the order used for the criteria.

BlockStart.name: Block Start
BlockStart.definition: Index of the first transaction matching the search criteria.

BlockStop.name: Block Stop
BlockStop.definition: Index of the last transaction matching the search criteria.
